summary_1line: Sikhandin challenges Bhishma as Arjuna supports him; Bhishma devastates the Pandava forces while vowing a decisive outcome on the tenth day.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sikhandin stands in his chariot loosing arrows at Bhishma while Arjuna’s chariot with Krishna behind him advances in support.
Bhishma, white-bannered and blazing with arrows, stands at the front of the Kuru army mowing down ranks of warriors on the tenth day.
Arjuna with Krishna as charioteer roars like a lion and rains arrows across the battlefield, scattering terrified Kuru soldiers.
